_comment: Weight map and default parameters are from Allora's online-learning paper (Kruijssen et al., arXiv:2501.16519): potential phi_{p,c}(x)=ln[1+e^{p(x-c)}] (Eq. 10), gradient phi'_{p,c}(x)=p/(e^{-p(x-c)}+1) (Eq. 11), fiducial p=3 at c=0.75 for regression, p=5 for classification; regret EMA alpha recommended ~0.1 for adaptability. Regrets are normalized by their cross-worker standard deviation before mapping. The 5-model ensemble below is an ILLUSTRATIVE worked example (ETH 5-minute volatility prediction): the per-regime forecast losses are hand-picked to show context-aware re-weighting, not measured on-chain values.
